nodes.description: Mapping (address => uint256) balances holding token balance of each holder in StandardToken.
Mapping (address => mapping (address => uint256)) allowed storing ERC20 allowances.
Public uint256 totalSupply declared in StandardToken.
Public string name of the ERC20Token, set to Islam.
Public uint8 decimals of the ERC20Token, set to 18.
Public string symbol of the ERC20Token, set to ISLM.
Public string version, initialized to H1.0.
StandardToken.transfer(address _to, uint256 _value): checks balances[msg.sender] >= _value then decrements sender and increments recipient.
StandardToken.transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value): moves tokens using the allowed allowance of msg.sender.
StandardToken.balanceOf(address _owner) constant: returns balances[_owner].
StandardToken.approve(address _spender, uint256 _value): sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
StandardToken.allowance(address _owner, address _spender) constant: returns allowed[_owner][_spender].
ERC20Token fallback function that unconditionally throws.
ERC20Token constructor: assigns fixed balance to msg.sender, sets totalSupply = totalSupply (no-op), name, decimals and symbol.
ERC20Token.approveAndCall(address _spender, uint256 _value, bytes _extraData): approves then performs an external call to _spender.
msg.sender used in StandardToken.transfer as the debited holder.
msg.sender used in StandardToken.transferFrom as the approved spender.
msg.sender used in StandardToken.approve as the allowance owner.
msg.sender used in ERC20Token constructor as the initial token holder.
msg.sender used in approveAndCall as the allowance owner.
balances[msg.sender] -= _value in transfer: state decrement relying only on a soft require, exposed to arithmetic underflow.
balances[_from] -= _value in transferFrom: unchecked state decrement of a mapping balance.
allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom: unchecked allowance decrement.
Low-level _spender.call(...) inside approveAndCall that forwards control to an arbitrary address before the function returns.

edges.reason: _to parameter is used as the recipient address in StandardToken.transfer.
_value parameter drives the amount moved by transfer.
_from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
_to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
_value parameter drives the amount moved by transferFrom.
_owner parameter indexes balances in balanceOf.
_spender parameter becomes the allowance key in approve.
_value parameter is written into the allowance in approve.
_owner parameter indexes allowed in allowance.
_spender parameter indexes allowed in allowance.
_spender parameter is the target of the external call in approveAndCall.
_value parameter is approved and forwarded in approveAndCall.
_extraData parameter is forwarded verbatim to the external callee.
_value is subtracted from balances[msg.sender] with no explicit underflow guard.
_value is subtracted from balances[_from] in transferFrom.
_value is subtracted from allowed[_from][msg.sender] in transferFrom.
_spender is the destination address of the low-level call.
msg.sender supplies the holder key for the balances write in transfer.
msg.sender supplies the spender key of the allowed mapping in transferFrom.
msg.sender supplies the owner key of the allowance write in approve.
msg.sender receives the entire initial supply in the constructor.
msg.sender supplies the allowance owner key in approveAndCall.
msg.sender indexes the balances slot decremented in transfer.
msg.sender indexes the allowed mapping decremented in transferFrom.
transfer writes to the balances mapping.
transferFrom writes to the balances mapping.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
constructor mints the initial balance for msg.sender.
constructor executes totalSupply = totalSupply, a self-assignment that leaves totalSupply unaffected.
constructor assigns the name string.
constructor assigns decimals.
constructor assigns the symbol string.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] before the external call.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall reaches the untrusted low-level call before completing its own state updates and return.
The callee invoked through _spender.call can re-enter approveAndCall or other token functions while the call is in flight.
Both the fallback and approveAndCall are externally reachable entry points of ERC20Token; the fallback reverts while approveAndCall proceeds.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is a purely local argument consumed only by StandardToken.transfer and has no independent identity in the graph.
_value is the exact operand subtracted inside transfer's unchecked balance decrement.
_from is only used to index balances and allowed inside transferFrom.
_to is only used to index the credited balances entry inside transferFrom.
_value is the exact operand subtracted from both balances[_from] and allowed[_from][msg.sender].
_owner is a read-only lookup key for the balances mapping inside balanceOf.
_spender is only used as the allowance key written by approve.
_value is only assigned into allowed[msg.sender][_spender] by approve.
_owner is a read-only lookup key for the allowed mapping inside allowance.
_spender is a read-only lookup key for the allowed mapping inside allowance.
_spender is both the allowance key and the untrusted target address of the low-level call.
_value is only used for the approval and the forwarded calldata in approveAndCall.
_extraData is opaque attacker-controlled bytes forwarded directly into the external call payload.
